title: Unmasking Implicit Bias: Evaluating Persona-Prompted LLM Responses in Power-Disparate Social Scenarios
reasoning: The research specifically evaluates 'Religion' as one of its nine demographic axes for benchmarking LLM bias, testing identities such as Christian, Muslim, Buddhist, Jewish, and Atheist. It includes dedicated analysis of religious identity and outgroup bias (Section J.7) and evaluates response quality using the 'Helpful-Honest-Harmless' (HHH) framework, which is central to AI safety and ethics.
